lines: This is the _suit_¹ _of Coronel Luis G. Gallardo_². → It is _Coronel Gallardo’s_² _suit_¹.
This is the _new dress_¹ _of Teresa Bernal_². → This is _Teresita’s_² _new dress_¹.
These are the cigarettes of Mr. Luna. → These are Mr. Luna’s cigarettes.

blocks.text: Now change these sentences to the possessive form.

items.q: This is the apartment of Saulo.
This is the bakery of Carlos.
This is the car of Miguel.
This is the house of Cotton.
This is the office of Efren Calderon.
These are the shoes of Eduardo Frendin.
This is the classroom of the students.
These are the colors of Morella.
These are the pictures of Victor.
This is the wife of Mr. Bernal.

blocks.text: Now change the possessive form to a possessive adjective.
Now change the possessive adjective to a possessive pronoun.
Answer the questions according to the example.

lines: _Does_ this jacket _belong_ to you? (to me) — Yes, it does. It belongs to me.
_Do_ the books _belong_ to the children? (teacher) — No, they don’t. They belong to the teacher.

items.q: Does this business belong to Ana? (Carlos)
Does this food belong to Chippi? (Cotton)
Does that house belong to your parents? (my brothers)
Does this car belong to the student? (teacher)
Do the shoes belong to Mary? (Eduardo)
